recent.text: In order to make the playoffs, the #SeaKraken basically have to finish 3rd in the Pacific. Very few paths to the wildcard. Competing with just the Ducks, right? Watch out for the Kings. Underlying numbers are much better than their results so far and could plausibly threaten.
